name: icewind_elemental_draws_then_discards_the_drawn_card
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, draw a card, then discard a card.' Seat 0 holds Kept Card; its library has Card A on top. Icewind Elemental enters: seat 0 draws Card A first, then discards a card of its choice: the card it just drew, which is only possible because the draw comes first. Kept Card stays in hand.
